message.content:
I don’t see the drones’ reports at all—they go straight to the companies. But I’ve heard from the companies that sometimes their systems get overwhelmed when a lot of drones are flying, and reports can pile up or take a little longer to process. It’s not my fault, though—I just keep the airspace data straight.

If a report is delayed, the companies handle it themselves. They’ve got their own ways of tracking what’s happening with their drones.
